name: Factual Consensus
description: Multi-model consensus verification for factual claims that compares evidentially distinguishable possible worlds.

inputs.name: evidence_bundle
inputs.description: Normalized evidence bundle with claims, metrics, and model runs.

inputs.name: program_context
inputs.description: Execution context including hashes, provenance, and chain metadata.

outputs.name: verification_receipt
outputs.description: Canonical receipt containing score, verdict, and explainability.

steps.description: Extract and normalize claims from the evidence bundle.
For each claim, compare the possible world in which the evidence supports it with rival worlds in which it is false or incomplete, then assess whether the evidence distinguishes them.
Combine component scores into a final basis-point score.
Emit a verification receipt with explainability metadata.

interpretation_alternatives.label: Ordinary reading
interpretation_alternatives.description: The statement is read using its ordinary language, scope, and timeframe.

interpretation_alternatives.label: Qualified reading
interpretation_alternatives.description: The statement is read with material limits, exceptions, scope, or timeframe made explicit.
